description: The organization has not established a formal IT governance structure. This signal indicates the absence of defined oversight mechanisms for technology risk management and security decision-making as required by SOC 2 Common Criteria.
applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations providing technology services, Organizations requiring formal IT governance

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing governance documentation, examining board and committee structures, and verifying IT oversight mechanisms are in place.

name: IT Governance Structure Missing
